paper_metadata.title: Thermo-Mechanical Properties and Oxidation Behavior of FeCrAl Alloys with Si and Y Addition

evidence.quote: This study investigates the impact of silicon and yttrium additions on the thermal-mechanical properties and high-temperature oxidation resistance of FeCrAl alloy.
